{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stone Grotto''' was a fancy dinner club in [[Drev'starn]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. It had a strict [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] code, enforced by [[Unidentified maitre d'|its ''maitre d''']]. [[Unidentified waiter droid|A waiter droid]] drifted reciting specialties and taking orders.
==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|a syndicate courier]] with [[Unidentified Rodian partner|his Rodian partner]] had a late night reservation for the club. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] had been [[death/Legends|murdered]] that night, and the courier went there alone, carrying a much-coveted briefcase. 

Indeed, a gang waited out of the facility while two of them, sharply dressed, but armed with [[stun gun/Legends|stun guns]], approached the courier; they seized him, claiming the briefcase hidden under the courier’s table.

The waiting droid was confused when a group of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel Intelligence]] [[operative]]s entered, as [[Unidentified courier lookalike|one of them]] looked like that courier. Right then, they noticed the hostage situation which erupted into chaos. When the Rebels tried to intervene, [[Unidentified Rodian kidnapper|one of the kidnappers]] brandished a [[thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and threatened to destroy the entire club, and attempted to grab along the courier's unfortunate look-alike. Just as their escape seemed certain, [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] police forces stormed the area, sealing off the streets outside and forcing the desperate kidnappers into a final, dangerous standoff inside the club.
